notes: Large-scale spacecraft fire (Cygnus). Solid cabin materials (Silicone, SIBAL, PMMA, Nomex). O2 column has fuzzy values '~ 21.5' and '22.1 to 22.0' -> strip '~', ranges to midpoint (team decision). No pressure column -> blank (strict policy; Cygnus cabin pressure not tabulated in the record). airflow values carry inline unit ('20 cm/s') -> strip. sample_size from 'Sample Length' in cm (->mm); messy entries like '5 and 24 cm' -> take the max number. Metric: the microgravity spread column is headed '?-g Spread Length' but its values are rates in mm/s (e.g. '2.6 mm/s'); mapped as spread_rate, 'n/a' -> blank. outcome: 'Insignificant' burn time -> no_ignition, otherwise burned.
